free_tier_limits: New accounts receive $5 in API credits without a credit card; credits expire after 30 days. Eligible Free Tier models allow 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 tokens/day per model.
rate_limits: Published by model and tier. Eligible Free Tier models: 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 TPD per model. Developer limits vary by model and include a 20-million-token daily limit across all models.
description: SambaCloud is an RDU-powered, high-throughput inference platform for supported open-source models. Developers create self-service API keys and use OpenAI-compatible APIs, including Chat Completions and Responses. Hosted models are designated for production or preview workloads.
resolution_notes: docs_url: update; current page: https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/get-started/overview. free_tier: true; $5/no card/30-day expiry: https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans. free_tier_limits and rate_limits: use published tier/model caps: https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits. example: 3.1-8B removed 2026-04-14; use 3.3-70B: https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/deprecations. description: official page specifies open-source models, RDUs, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints: https://sambanova.ai/products/sambacloud
